summary: PagSeguro Digital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the filing of its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. The filing is a routine disclosure of financial results and provides no information about any transaction, corporate action, or special situation. No deal terms, stake percentages, prices, premiums, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The document is purely a regulatory update for a foreign private issuer, containing no event that would classify it as a special situation. This is a standard periodic filing with no actionable event.
